name: admin.apps.permissions.remove
purpose: Revoke an entity's access to an app that has its permission type set to named_entities

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs whose named_entities access will be revoked.

channel_ids.desc: List of encoded channel IDs to remove from the channel restriction list. Interpretation depends on the app's channel_restriction_mode, which is configured via the admin.apps.permissions.set method.
